acceptance_rule: Canonical three-window Gate 1-4 after costs; at least 20 target trades across all three windows and at least 3 tickers; beat the closest accepted candidate-pool comparator without unacceptable drawdown or concentration; default-off only.

hub_identity.reservation_rule: Reserve the ticket (atomic O_EXCL create) before writing runners, artifacts, data, or logs. Existing IDs are rejected across registry, JSONL, tickets, logs, artifacts, data, and runners.

hypothesis: candidate_pool: a mapped public drug sponsor's first ClinicalTrials.gov Phase 3 results posting, confirmed by an issuer green day that outperforms SPY, should reveal underreaction that continues from the next open through the tenth trading-day close.

nearest.reopen_condition: A retry needs materially stronger relation identity evidence, such as CIK-level counterparty extraction from exhibits, a customer/supplier graph, deal target/holder role labels, or closed forward replacement rows. Do not sweep public-name alias lists, relation phrase lists, item codes, RS/close/volume guards, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.

A retry needs materially new PIT evidence separating growth financing from distress/dilution, such as use-of-proceeds text, covenant maturity context, forward daily replacement value, or a shared default-off source with daily parity observations. Pure subtype/threshold retunes stay frozen.

A retry needs materially new PIT timing evidence, such as ticker-specific historical filing cadence relative to its own prior deadlines, auditor-change context, or forward daily replacement value from a shared default-off adapter. Pure 10-Q/10-K lag threshold retunes stay frozen.

novelty.new_evidence_axis: New official data source: versioned ClinicalTrials.gov Phase 3 ResultsFirstPostDate records, with exact first-post history snapshots; 74 non-inert fixed-rule candidates span 12 issuers and all three canonical windows.

observed_only_streak_guard.rule: AGENTS.md §2.4 forward-row attribution: after 3 consecutive observed-only closes on one data_source population, a further observed-only probe needs materially more settled rows, a new data source, or a new gate shape.

reopen_condition_guard.rule: If a parked surface has a quantitative reopen_condition, alpha-lane reservations that target that surface are blocked until the numeric reopen checks pass, unless the ticket names a genuinely new data source or a new gate shape.

Fault recovery is exempt.

post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The source generated 47 trades and positive PnL in all windows, but the edge averaged only about $29.52 per trade, one window's EV regressed, and 95.65% of positive contribution came from five tickers.
post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retune sponsor aliases or map, green/SPY thresholds, rank, cooldown, hold, notional, costs, or window slices on this frozen ClinicalTrials source.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A genuinely new clinical-results semantic direction or endpoint source with audited point-in-time labels, or at least 30 closed forward replacement-value rows.

prediction.confidence_reason: No prior ClinicalTrials.gov source exists; readiness found 250 Phase 3 first-post events and 74 fixed-rule candidates across 12 tickers and all three windows, while exact Record History versions make the first-post fields auditable. The main disconfirmers are delayed disclosure and sector concentration.

reopen_condition: A retry requires a genuinely new clinical-results semantic direction or endpoint source with audited point-in-time labels, or at least 30 closed forward replacement-value rows; do not retune the current map or gates.
residual_unknowns: Exact selected history versions are frozen, but the version change-lists proving earliest-results status are not frozen for offline re-audit.
Current exact-sponsor retrieval can miss studies whose sponsor later changed away from a preregistered name.

calibration.surprise_note: The new source was broad and profitable in aggregate but economically immaterial, one-window EV-regressive, and highly concentrated.

result.summary: 47 trades across 9 tickers and 3 windows; positive aggregate EV/PnL but rejected for window stability, concentration, comparator, and daily parity failures
